subject.title: Control UI: drag sessions from the sidebar into split view with animated drop preview

question: Should Control UI add sidebar-session drag/drop into split panes now, and should the implementation reuse the existing private session drag payload with pane-local drop zones?
rationale: This is a new user-facing interaction with animation, accessibility, reduced-motion, existing attachment-drop, and protected-label product implications that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Sponsor bounded drag/drop
options.body: Implement the requested sidebar drag sources, pane drop zones, animated preview, reduced-motion handling, and focused Control UI tests on top of the existing split-layout model.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Start with a simpler center-drop-to-open behavior or non-animated preview before adding edge insertion and easing.

options.title: Defer to existing controls
options.body: Keep the shipped header split buttons and per-pane selectors as the supported workflow until stronger demand justifies drag/drop complexity.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded drag/drop
recommendation.body: Implement the requested sidebar drag sources, pane drop zones, animated preview, reduced-motion handling, and focused Control UI tests on top of the existing split-layout model.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored both this request and the merged split-view foundation that defines the product boundary.
